integrity: Exact integer-only enumeration of all 4096 configurations, two independent adjacency constructions, all 88 field-interval path checks, 48 automorphisms; no historical priority or independent scientific validation claimed.

title: Two peaked activation barriers for single-spin traps of the Ising cuboctahedron
